security_cases: oversized input is rejected before expensive work
user-controlled text is rendered with textContent or escaped
NaN, Infinity, invalid dimensions and overflow produce explicit errors
responsive_accessibility_cases: 320px viewport has no page-level horizontal scroll
keyboard-only interaction reaches every actionable control with visible focus
result region uses role=status and aria-live=polite
performance_cases: normal calculation requires no server request
loops and row counts are bounded
heavy work is absent or route-lazy
tool_specific: Internal baffles, wall thickness, dead storage, freeboard, tank deformation and local septic sizing rules are not included.
